description: Source code implementing virtual input event handlers and a controller class for managing IPC communication related to virtual keyboard, mouse, and touch events in the Thunder::VirtualInput namespace.

classes.name: KeyEventHandler
classes.description: Handles key events via IPC, invoking a callback with action and code.

classes.name: MouseEventHandler
classes.description: Handles mouse events via IPC, invoking a callback with action, button, horizontal, and vertical parameters.

classes.name: TouchEventHandler
classes.description: Handles touch events via IPC, invoking a callback with action, index, X, and Y parameters.

classes.name: Controller
classes.description: Manages IPC channels for virtual input events, registering handlers for key, mouse, and touch events, and providing mode information.

classes.name: NameEventHandler
classes.description: Handles name-related IPC messages, setting name and mode in responses.

methods.name: virtualinput_open
methods.description: Creates and returns a new Controller instance for virtual input handling.

methods.name: virtualinput_close
methods.description: Deletes the Controller instance, closing IPC channels.

methods.name: virtualinput_dispose
methods.description: Disposes of singleton resources related to core.
